title: opscotch Bootstrap array
description: The initial configuration for the opscotch agent

record.title: opscotch Bootstrap record
record.description: The individual bootstrap configuration record for the opscotch agent bootstrap

enabled.description: Setting to false disables the loading of this bootstrap

agentPrivateKey.description: The private key for the agent to decrypt the remote configuration

persistenceRoot.description: Defines the filesystem storage root for persistence

deploymentId.description: A Service Provider defined value that must be unique per deployed agent configuration

keys.description: A list of keys that are available to workflows for cryptographic usage

remoteConfiguration.description: A URL or file path to the main configuration

remoteConfigurationAuth.description: When using a URL remoteConfiguration, setting this property will set the Authorization header

remoteConfigurationHeaders.description: When using a URL remoteConfiguration, these headers are added to the HTTP request

remoteConfigurationTimeout.description: When using a URL remoteConfiguration, sets the HTTP timeout in milliseconds. When frequency > 0, this value must be less than frequency.

frequency.description: Sets how often configuration updates are checked in milliseconds. For URL remoteConfiguration this is HTTP polling. For file remoteConfiguration this controls whether update watching is enabled. Set to 0 to disable all updates after startup (load once only).

deferLoading.description: When true, each step initializes only trigger wiring at startup and defers full step setup until first execution.

startupPriority.description: Startup activation ordering priority across deployments in the bootstrap. Lower numbers activate first.

errorHandling.description: Determines the behavior of error handling while loading the main configuration

workflow.description: Determines the behaviour of error handling and metrics for the workflow

errorHandling.description: Determines the behavior of error handling while loading the main configuration

outputs.description: Additional outputs that can be referenced by id from workflows

shutdownTimeout.description: Sets how long to wait in milliseconds for active workflow runs to finish during agent shutdown before the shared HTTP client is closed and in-flight HTTP calls are cancelled.

maxTimerConcurrency.description: Sets the maximum number of active executions allowed from one workflow timer. Null uses no per-timer limit.

timers.description: Controls bootstrap-time behavior for workflow timers

staggerPct.description: Applies a one-time randomized startup delay to repeating workflow timers. Valid range is 0..100.

reloadTimeout.description: Defines the maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a workflow to terminate

data.description: Additional properties that will be merged with the main configuration data field and be available to all child elements in the main configuration tree (expect the hosts property)

licenseHost.description: Host to use for obtaining a license

licenseHostPoolId.description: Specify a license pool to use

packaging.description: Defines how to open the packaged configuration

packageId.description: This packageId must match the packageId field in the package to ensure that the expected package is being deployed

requiredSigners.description: A list of signers signatures that must be present in the package

requiredAdditionalSignerCount.description: Set the number of additional signers required from the `additionalSigners` list

packagerIdentities.description: A list of public key ids of packaging identities that proves the authenticity of the package. The private key for this package deployment must be in the `keys` list.

agentControl.description: Controls behaviour that allows workflows to influence the agent lifecycle

workflowCanShutdownAgent.description: Allow workflows to request that the agent shuts down

key.description: A key used to perform cryptographic operations in the agent and workflows. Each key has a specific required length and purpose.

id.description: A unique identifier used to reference a specific key

purpose.description: Cryptographic purpose this key is used for: sign - digital signatures, authenticated - mutual public/private authenticated encryption, symmetric - symmetric key encryption, anonymous - anonymous public key encryption

type.description: Whether this key is public or secret

signer.description: A signer is a key that is used to sign, or verifiy the signature of data

id.description: Unique identifier for this signer - it should match the id of the key used to sign the package

host.title: opscotch remote host definition
host.description: A HTTP(S) host that the agent is expected to communicate with

id.description: A unique string that identifies this host in workflow configurations

host.description: A URL that is used as the base for constructing URLs to call

transport.description: Defines how this host is reached

inProcServerId.description: When transport is inProc, identifies the bootstrap http server to route to internally

inProcDeploymentId.description: When transport is inProc, optionally route to a different deploymentId

headers.description: A object of HTTP headers to be sent with every call

allowList.description: A list of allowed <http method, url path> tuples that may be called on this host

data.description: Additional properties that will accessible during authentication steps

httpTimeout.description: Default http timeout in milliseconds for steps that call this host

enableLocalLogging.description: Enable or disables logging of errors and information to the agent standard out

metrics.description: Defines how error metrics are sent to a remote system

logs.description: Defines how error logs are sent to a remote system

redactionPatterns.description: Defines regex patterns to apply redaction to log statements

output.title: opscotch Output Handling
output.description: Configuration for how to send data to a remote system

id.description: A unique id used to reference this output from workflows

enabled.description: Enables or disables the sending of data

type.description: The output type. When set to 'otel', an OTEL sender is used

typeProperties.description: Type-specific properties keyed by the type name

endpoint.description: OTLP endpoint for the OTEL exporter

routingToken.description: A Service Provider defined value that must be unique per deployed agent

outputUrl.description: The URL that data is transmitted to

persistenceRoot.description: Sets the persistence root for the output queue storage

id.description: An id that must be unique to this bootstrap

directoryOrFile.description: A path to a directory or file

patterns.description: A list of (Java) Regular Expressions that can be used to further restrict access to files in the directory

READ.description: When true files will be readable

LIST.description: When true directories will be listable

WRITE.description: When true files will be writable

DELETE.description: When true files will be deletable

required.description: if set to true the file or directory must exist

httpServerPermitter.title: opscotch Http Server Permitter
httpServerPermitter.description: Define controlled access to a server

id.description: An id that must be unique to this bootstrap

port.description: Set the port - must be unique to the host

tcp.description: When true this server will allow TCP triggers

inProcOnly.description: When true, this server will not bind to a network port and will only be available for in-process routing

serveFromPackagedAsset.description: Defines how to serve static files from a packaged asset (zip file)

deploymentAccessPermitter.title: opscotch Deployment Access Permitter
deploymentAccessPermitter.description: Define controlled access between deployments in the same agent

id.description: An id that must be unique to this bootstrap

deploymentId.description: Legacy shorthand for a single deploymentId in the access group (preferred shape is deploymentIds)

deploymentIds.description: The deploymentIds that belong to this access group

anyDeployment.description: When access is receive, allow calls from any deployment

startupWaitTimeoutMs.description: When access is call, maximum time in milliseconds to wait for target deployment startup readiness during cross-deployment calls.

access.description: Access mode for this deployment link
